audit: class-3 control audit, 1912 ring 1 (east of Ave L and the 18th St row)

method.crops: per plate: 900 px across the corridor (jittered +-180 px) x 1500 px along it, centred on the plate's extent centre on the along axis, native 1:1, ruler ticks every 50 px labelled in crop-local px; plus a half-scale full-length identity strip (avenues rotated so the lettering reads horizontally)
readers: A: automated ink-profile rule detector (native px, sub-px centroid; extent-centre window +-750 px along the corridor)
B: visual read of the blind crop (ruler in jittered crop-local px, converted to native after reading; +-5 px)
method.honesty: No sub-agent spawning tool was available in this session, so the two readers are (A) an automated ink-profile detector that knows nothing about the filed values and (B) the lead reading the blind crops. Reader B's crops were labelled in crop-local px with a hidden random origin (offsets.json in the scratchpad, not opened until all 30 crops had been read), so the filed values could not be matched while reading. Reader B is therefore blind to the numbers but not to the fact that the controls were under suspicion.
method.half_widths: where a plate draws only one face, midpoint = face +- half the drafted roadway of that corridor class: 121.5 px for 80 ft streets (drafted 241-244 px on plates 26, 40, 41, 44, 45, 50, 51; sheet 26 draws 18th St in full at 242.6 px) and 106 px for 70 ft avenues (206-214 px fully drawn on 34, 35, 40, 41, 45, 85, 93). Ave L is 70 ft: '70'' is printed with its name on sheets 20 and 85 (class3_crops/check_u20_AveL_strip.jpg, check_u85_AveL_strip.jpg) and it measures ~206-211 px on sheet 93.
method.decision_rule: a control is corrected when both readers agree and either a filed value differs from face+-half-width by more than 12 px, or the pair's implied roadway width differs from the drafted class width by more than 12 px (the pair-level error is what the seam sees).

controls.evidence: Both readers reproduce the file's own faces (40 west face 3110.5/3104 vs file 3111; 41 east face 264.9/268 vs file 264). The error is the half-width: the file adds 121 px (80 ft) but Avenue L is a 70 ft avenue - sheet 20 prints 'AVENUE L.' with 70' at both ends of the name (class3_crops/check_u20_AveL_strip.jpg), sheet 85 prints 'AVENUE L' with 70' (check_u85_AveL_strip.jpg), sheet 93 draws it ~206-211 px wide, and every other accepted Ave L control (24|25 roadway 206/206, 30|31 face+-106.8, 44|45 face+-106/107, 56|57 face-106.5, 20|25, 85|93) uses the 70 ft width. The rotated '80'' figures beside Ave L belong to the 80 ft cross streets (the same rotated '80'' appears beside the fully drawn 212 px Ave F on sheet 34). As filed the pair drafts Ave L 243 px wide instead of ~212: a 31 px (10 ft) seam error, matching the +12/+8 ft band residual. Local re-solve (units 41 45 51) with the corrected values: pair_40_41 residual +7.0 ft -> -0.9 ft.
